topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Stem cells and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role of tissue stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin models in tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental signals, inflammation, and stromal support in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how microenvironmental factors, inflammatory signals, and supportive stroma promote neoplastic growth and provide therapeutic targets.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the laboratory models, sequencing technologies, and spatial omics methods used to study cancer evolution.

topics.label: Integrated synthesis of cancer evolution mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how mutational processes, cell of origin, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental conditions interact to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of next session
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
